place: an Airbus superjumbo rolling down a runway at dusk, seen along its left wing
under the wing as the wheels leave the runway

moments.what: glowing air lines start streaming back over the wing
the wing's edge lights catch
the nose rotates up and the main wheels leave the runway
the camera pulls out to the whole superjumbo, a label writes on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Why does this wing lift Airbus's superjumbo?

place: the superjumbo seen from above on the apron, a tape bracket from wingtip to wingtip
a classroom blackboard with the textbook wing drawn in chalk

moments.what: two chalk-white arrows sketch over the left wing from above
the chalk arrows flicker and crack away
the camera glides over the superjumbo from above, its wings lit
a bracket stretches from wingtip to wingtip
the bracket's ends flash at the wingtips
the wingspan figure lands on the bracket
cut to a blackboard: a wing section drawn in chalk
a chalk label writes on over the board
two chalk dots appear at the wing's front edge
the curved top of the chalk wing glows
a chalk dot starts over the top
the top dot speeds up, chalk streaks behind it
both dots meet at the back edge, a chalk circle round them
the bottom dot's path glows under the wing

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It isn't the reason you learned. Its wings span 79.8 metres. At school we learn air over the curved top must hurry to meet the air underneath.

params.place: a dark wind tunnel test section, a wing slice on its mount, glowing streamlines

moments.what: the tunnel's lamps flicker on
glowing streamlines flow past the wing slice
two bright puffs sit side by side ahead of the wing
the puffs split at the front edge, one over, one under
the streamlines brighten as the air speeds up
the tunnel's ribs and fan glow behind
the camera tracks the top puff racing over the wing
the top puff shoots past the back edge
a flash at the back edge, a 'first' tag on the top puff
the bottom puff is still under the wing, far behind
a red cross on the meeting point at the back edge
the cross pulses and a 'no meeting' label writes on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Now follow two puffs of air through a wind tunnel. The top one reaches the back first. They never meet again.

params.place: an office at night, a paper plane gliding over the desks

moments.what: a flat sheet folds itself into a paper plane on a desk
the paper plane launches off the desk
it glides out over the office
close side view: its wing is a dead-flat sheet, a label writes on
the plane holds its glide
the camera pulls back as it sails across the room
the plane's wing tilts up a little and glows
a few air lines bend down off its back edge
the camera follows it on

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: And a flat paper plane, with no curved top at all, still flies. So what is a wing really doing?

params.place: back in the wind tunnel, the wing slice tilting on its mount

moments.what: the streamlines run flat into the level wing
the wing slice tilts nose-up on its mount, an angle arc draws on
the angle arc glows
the streamlines bend: up ahead of the wing, down behind it
lines far above and below bend too
the flow glows brighter along every line
a big amber arrow points down out of the back edge
close on the air pouring down off the back edge

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: It meets the air tilted up a little, and it turns the whole stream of air downward behind it.

params.place: the superjumbo flying above the clouds, its wing cut open to show the slice

moments.what: the superjumbo cruises over the clouds, its wing cut open at a slice
fast air lines race over the slice's top
a blue low-pressure glow spreads over the top, a label writes on
the blue glow pulses
an amber glow fills under the slice
amber arrows press up on the wing's underside
the arrows grow
a big upward arrow rises out of the wing
the whole plane lifts a little in the frame

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Air speeding over the top drops in pressure, the air below presses harder, and the wing is pushed up.

params.place: low beside the runway as the superjumbo lifts off, the air below it blasting down

moments.what: a sheet of air rushes down off the wing onto the runway
grass beside the runway flattens in a wave
runway dust sprays out sideways
a big arrow up from the wing answers the arrow down
the superjumbo climbs away
the up arrow glows amber

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: Push air down, and the air pushes the wing back up.

place: the superjumbo climbing out at dusk, seen from the side
along the left wing on the runway, as the video began

moments.what: the superjumbo climbs at dusk, gear tucking up
its fuselage lights up from nose to tail
air lines stream down behind the wing
the figure writes onto the fuselage side
the figure counts up beside the fuselage
the figure lands and pulses amber
the plane rides on the glowing downwash
cut to along the left wing: air lines pour down off it
the downwash glows
the camera settles on the hook's first frame: the wing on the runway

beats.speaker: narrator
beats.say: At its heaviest take-off, that push holds up 575 tonnes, all hanging on air thrown down by its two wings.

disclaimer: Animations are simplified illustrations, not exact to scale.

references.what: a clean 3D airliner in flight over a blue sky with glowing air lines, a few big words

thumbnail.pattern: the reference sells the airliner itself in clean 3D; ours keeps the superjumbo wing big on its runway with glowing air lines over it and three words asking the question
